50544-the-life-of-general-garibaldi-tran.title: To The Present Time.
50544-the-life-of-general-garibaldi-tran.creator: Unknown
50544-the-life-of-general-garibaldi-tran.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ribaldi requested that they might be withholden from the public while he remained in this country, probably because he preferred to be unnoticed, being at that time employed in making candles on Staten Island, and naturally fond of retirement.

60427-introducing-irony-a-book-of-poetic.title: Stories And Poems
60427-introducing-irony-a-book-of-poetic.creator: Unknown
60427-introducing-irony-a-book-of-poetic.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. damp alleys of his time,   Immersed in that brisk midnight known as crime. He shunned the fiercely shrewd stuff that he sold   To other people, and derived a cold   Enjoyment from the writhing of their hearts. A speechless artist, he admired the arts   Of blundering destruction, like a monk   Viewing a play that made him mildly drunk.

arxiv-2102-03533.title: Holographic Anomalous Current at a Finite Temperature
arxiv-2102-03533.description: Abstract Weyl anomaly leads to novel anomalous currents in a spacetime with boundaries. Recently it is found that the anomalous current can be significantly enhanced by the high temperature for free theories, which could make the experimental measurement easier. In this paper, we investigate holographic anomalous currents at a finite temperature.

arxiv-2201-07726.title: “Learn the Facts About COVID-19”: Analyzing the Use of Warning Labels on TikTok Videos
arxiv-2201-07726.creator: Chen Ling, Krishna P. Gummadi, Savvas Zannettou, [0.5ex] Boston University, Max Planck Institute for Software Systems, TU Delft, Max Planck Institute for Informaticsccling@bu.edu, gummadi@mpi-sws.org, s.zannettou@tudelft.nl
arxiv-2201-07726.description: Abstract During the COVID-19 pandemic, health-related misinformation and harmful content shared online had a significant adverse effect on society. In an attempt to mitigate this adverse effect, mainstream social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter, and TikTok employed soft moderation interventions (i.e., warning labels) on potentially harmful posts.

arxiv-2205-05139.title: Dimers, webs, and local systems
arxiv-2205-05139.creator: Daniel C. Douglas, Richard Kenyon, Haolin Shi
arxiv-2205-05139.description: Abstract For a planar bipartite graph 𝒢 \mathcal{G} equipped with a SL n \mathrm{SL}_{n} -local system, we show that the determinant of the associated Kasteleyn matrix counts “ n n -multiwebs” (generalizations of n n -webs) in 𝒢 \mathcal{G} , weighted by their web-traces. We use this fact to study random n n -multiwebs in graphs on some simple surfaces.

arxiv-2208-02157.title: Integrated Sensing and Communication for 6G: Ten Key Machine Learning Roles
arxiv-2208-02157.creator: Umut Demirhan, Ahmed Alkhateeb
arxiv-2208-02157.description: Abstract Integrating sensing and communication is a defining theme for future wireless systems. This is motivated by the promising performance gains, especially as they assist each other, and by the better utilization of the wireless and hardware resources. Realizing these gains in practice, however, is subject to several challenges where leveraging machine learning can provide a potential solution.

arxiv-2306-14852.title: CoarsenConf: Equivariant Coarsening with Aggregated Attention for Molecular Conformer Generation
arxiv-2306-14852.creator: Danny Reidenbach, Aditi S. Krishnapriyan
arxiv-2306-14852.description: Abstract Molecular conformer generation (MCG) is an important task in cheminformatics and drug discovery. The ability to efficiently generate low-energy 3D structures can avoid expensive quantum mechanical simulations, leading to accelerated virtual screenings and enhanced structural exploration. Several generative models have been developed for MCG, but many struggle to consistently produce high-quality conformers.

arxiv-2309-02728.title: Josephson quantum mechanics at odd parity
arxiv-2309-02728.creator: Manuel Houzet, Julia S. Meyer, Yuli V. Nazarov
arxiv-2309-02728.description: Abstract A Josephson junction may be in a stable odd parity state when a single quasiparticle is trapped in an Andreev bound state. Embedding such junction in an electromagnetic environment gives rise to a special quantum mechanics of superconducting phase that we investigate theoretically.

arxiv-2310-15551.title: Universal bifurcations to explosive synchronization for networks of coupled oscillators with higher-order interactions
arxiv-2310-15551.creator: Lauren D. Smith, Penghao Liu
arxiv-2310-15551.description: Abstract We determine critical parameter sets for transitions from gradual to explosive synchronization in coupled oscillator networks with higher-order coupling using self-consistency analysis. We obtain analytic bifurcation values for generic symmetric natural frequency distributions. We show that non-synchronized, drifting, oscillators are non-negligible, and play a crucial role in bifurcation.

arxiv-2405-19086.title: MEMoE: Enhancing Model Editing with Mixture of Experts Adaptors
arxiv-2405-19086.creator: Renzhi Wang, Piji Li ∗
arxiv-2405-19086.description: Abstract Model editing aims to efficiently alter the behavior of Large Language Models (LLMs) within a desired scope, while ensuring no adverse impact on other inputs. Recent years have witnessed various model editing methods been proposed. However, these methods either exhibit poor overall performance or struggle to strike a balance between generalization and locality.

arxiv-2408-06894.title: Exploring the generalizability of the optimal 0.234 acceptance rate in random-walk Metropolis and parallel tempering algorithms
arxiv-2408-06894.creator: Aidan Li, Liyan Wang, Tianye Dou, Jeffrey S. Rosenthal
arxiv-2408-06894.description: Abstract For random-walk Metropolis (RWM) and parallel tempering (PT) algorithms, an asymptotic acceptance rate of around 0.234 is known to be optimal in certain high-dimensional limits. However, its practical relevance is uncertain due to restrictive derivation conditions. We synthesise previous theoretical advances in extending the 0.

arxiv-2412-15208.title: OpenEMMA: Open-Source Multimodal Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2412-15208.creator: Shuo Xing, Chengyuan Qian, Yuping Wang, Hongyuan Hua, Kexin Tian, Yang Zhou, Zhengzhong Tu
arxiv-2412-15208.description: Abstract Since the advent of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), they have made a significant impact across a wide range of real-world applications, particularly in Autonomous Driving (AD). Their ability to process complex visual data and reason about intricate driving scenarios has paved the way for a new paradigm in end-to-end AD systems.

arxiv-2507-01512.title: Measuring spatial coherence of quantum and classical light with an ultrastable monolithic interferometer
arxiv-2507-01512.creator: Edoardo Suerra, Mirko Siano, Bruno Paroli, Samuele Altilia, Marco A. C. Potenza, Matteo G. A. Paris, Simone Cialdi
arxiv-2507-01512.description: Abstract We describe a monolithic interferometer for spatial coherence measurements of both classical and quantum light sources. The design combines parametric down-conversion with a thermal source, using two identical calcite crystals to control beam alignment via birefringence. The monolithic structure ensures inherent stability.

arxiv-2508-13431.title: Bell Inequality Violations Without Entanglement? It’s Just Postselection
arxiv-2508-13431.creator: Ken Wharton, Huw Price
arxiv-2508-13431.description: Abstract Recently Wang et al have reported a violation of a Bell inequality without entanglement. We show that their result is an artifact of postselection. It is well known that postselection may yield Bell inequality violations, both in classical toy models and in real experiments with delayed-choice entanglement-swapping.

arxiv-2601-07533.title: Loci Similes: A Benchmark for Extracting Intertextualities in Latin Literature
arxiv-2601-07533.creator: Julian Schelb, Michael Wittweiler, Marie Revellio, Barbara Feichtinger and Andreas Spitz
arxiv-2601-07533.description: Abstract Tracing connections between historical texts is an important part of intertextual research, enabling scholars to reconstruct the virtual library of a writer and identify the sources influencing their creative process. These intertextual links manifest in diverse forms, ranging from direct verbatim quotations to subtle allusions and paraphrases disguised by morphological variation.

arxiv-2601-17118.title: An Enhanced Isothermal Jeans Approach to Constraining Dark Matter Self-Interactions from Galactic Kinematics 2024 An Enhanced Isothermal Jeans Approach to Constraining Dark Matter Self-Interactions from Galactic Kinematics – References
arxiv-2601-17118.creator: Zixiang Jia, Fangzhou Jiang, Shubo Li, Ran Li, Jing Wang, Ling Zhu
arxiv-2601-17118.description: Abstract We present an improved semi-analytical model to predict density profiles of self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) halos and apply it to constrain the self-scattering cross section using SPARC galaxy rotation curves. Building on the isothermal Jeans approach, our model incorporates (i) velocity-dependent cross sections, (ii) an empirical treatment of core collapse, and (iii) enhanced robustness for identifying solutions.

arxiv-2602-17319.title: Quenched large deviations for randomly weighted geodesic random walks
arxiv-2602-17319.creator: Rik Versendaal
arxiv-2602-17319.description: Abstract We consider weighted geodesic random walks in a complete Riemannian manifold ( M , g ) (M,g) . We show that for almost all sequences of weights (with respect to a suitable measure), these weighted geodesic random walks satisfy, when suitably scaled, a large deviation principle with a universal rate function.

pmc-11418391.title: Benzenesulfonohydrazide-tethered non-fused and fused heterocycles as potential anti-mycobacterial agents targeting enoyl acyl carrier protein reductase (InhA) with antibiofilm activity†
pmc-11418391.creator: Tarfah Al-Warhi, Ahmed Sabt, Małgorzata Korycka-Machala, Asmaa F. Kassem, Moataz A. Shaldam, Hoda Atef Abdelsattar Ibrahim, Malwina Kawka, Bożena Dziadek, Magdalena Kuzioła, Wagdy M. Eldehna, Jarosław Dziadek
pmc-11418391.description: Because resistant variants of the disease are always emerging, tuberculosis is a global issue that affects economies. New antitubercular medications should be developed, and this can be done by inhibiting druggable targets. Enoyl acyl carrier protein (ACP) reductase (InhA) is a crucial enzyme for the survival of Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB).

pmc-11489582.title: Sirtuin 1 regulates the phenotype and functions of dendritic cells through Ido1 pathway in obesity
pmc-11489582.creator: Jean de Lima, Jefferson Antônio Leite, Paulo José Basso, Bruno Ghirotto, Eloisa Martins da Silva, Luisa Menezes-Silva, Meire Ioshie Hiyane, Carolina Purcell Goes, Luiz Lehmann Coutinho, Vinicius de Andrade Oliveira, Niels Olsen Saraiva Câmara
pmc-11489582.description: Sirtuin 1 (SIRT1) is a class III histone deacetylase (HDAC3) that plays a crucial role in regulating the activation and differentiation of dendritic cells (DCs) as well as controlling the polarization and activation of T cells. Obesity, a chronic inflammatory condition, is characterized by the activation of immune cells in various tissues.

pmc-11503288.title: Chemical, Textural and Antioxidant Properties of Oat-Fermented Beverages with Different Starter Lactic Acid Bacteria and Pectin
pmc-11503288.creator: Dmitrii V Khrundin, Elena V Nikitina, Jaime García-Mena
pmc-11503288.description: Currently, starter cultures for fermenting plant-based beverages are not widely available commercially, but producers can use starter cultures for dairy products. Therefore, the aim of this study was to determine the physicochemical, rheological, antioxidant and sensory properties of oat beverages with/without pectin fermented by four different dairy starter cultures.

pmc-11639473.title: Statistical fractal analysis in testing the Hypotheses with imprecise data
pmc-11639473.creator: D Kalpanapriya, N Shobana Devi, M Mubashir Unnissa, Dowlath Fathima
pmc-11639473.description: A new statistical hypothesis testing procedure using fractal analysis, incorporating the concept of lacunarity for interval population parameters when the sample data are real intervals, is introduced. The decision rules for accepting or rejecting the null and alternative hypotheses are provided, along with testing procedures and numerical examples.

pmc-12533073.title: PSO-DT based BagDT: a robust lightweight ensemble framework for efficient feature selection and DDoS attack detection in IoT environment
pmc-12533073.creator: J Jasmine Shirley, M Priya
pmc-12533073.description: The recent decade has seen enormous growth in the Internet of Things field. This development has significantly expanded the space for cyber-threats, among which the Distributed Denial of Service attacks have become one of the most important and common threats. These attacks might severely disrupt critical services if not detected and handled on time.

pmc-12709724.title: Comparative histomorphometric and transcriptomic analysis reveals potential genetic determinants of pelage variation between hairy and coarse-woolly sheep
pmc-12709724.creator: Qing Liang, Dejun Ji, Xianwei Wang, Xu Peng, Jingxin Zhang, Chenjuan Ge, Yulu Zheng, Tengyun Gao, Yinghua Shi, Zejun Xu, Tong Fu, Sen Ma
pmc-12709724.description: BackgroundThe unique pelage composition and developmental pattern endow hairy sheep with superior heat tolerance and minimized wool-shearing needs, compared with coarse-woolly sheep. However, the genetic mechanisms underlying pelage differentiation between these two sheep types remain incompletely understood to date, thereby limiting the development of molecular breeding strategies for cultivating climate-resilient and cost-effective sheep breeds in climate-changing era.

pmc-12946271.title: Transanal versus robotic total mesorectal excision for mid- and low-rectal cancer: A single-center comparative cohort of 109 patients
pmc-12946271.creator: Chang-Lin Lin, Ming-Cheng Chen, Chun-Yu Lin, Shih-Wei Chiang, Hou-Hsuan Cheng, Yen-Chen Shao, Shang-Chih Huang, Feng-Fan Chiang, Wei-Yuan Chen
pmc-12946271.description: Minimally invasive total mesorectal excision (TME) for rectal cancer can be performed via transanal TME (TaTME) or robotic TME (R-TME), yet comparative evidence in predominantly non-obese Asian cohorts remains limited. We evaluated a consecutive retrospective cohort during our institutional transition from TaTME to R-TME.

pmc-13075855.title: Short-term calcium peroxide application promotes soil microbial interactions to improve peanut yield in acidic soils
pmc-13075855.creator: Yunfei Yu, Xiaoxue Li, Azhar Sohail Shahzad, Shunyao Zhuang
pmc-13075855.description: The deterioration of soil microorganisms stands as a key barrier to the sustainable cultivation of peanut. Peroxides such as hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) and calcium peroxide (CaO2) with antimicrobial efficacy may inhibit soil pathogens and improve microbial community, but their effects on the soil properties, microbiome and peanut yield are still unclear.

pmc-13154141.title: Notch信号通路在儿童过敏性紫癜中的表达及其与炎症因子的相关性
pmc-13154141.creator: Huishan CHEN, Feng LI, Ying TANG, Ping ZENG, 方 余, 丽娜 刘
pmc-13154141.description: 目的研究过敏性紫癜（HSP）患儿外周血单个核细胞中Notch信号通路相关基因表达的特征及其与炎症因子水平的相关性。方法选取在广州医科大学附属妇女儿童医疗中心就诊的66例初发HSP患儿（复杂型HSP组30例，单纯型HSP组36例）及28名健康对照儿童，采用定量逆转录聚合酶链反应（qRT-PCR）检测外周血单个核细胞中NOTCH1~NOTCH4、JAG1、JAG2及HES1信使RNA（mRNA）表达，酶联免疫吸附试验检测血清IL-1β、IL-4、IL-6、IL-17、γ干扰素、肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-α）水平，并采用Spearman检验分析NOTCH1、NOTCH2 mRNA表达水平与配体编码基因JAG1、下游转录靶基因HES1 mRNA水平及炎症因子水平的相关性。结果与健康对照组比较，单纯型HSP组和复杂型HSP组NOTCH1、NOTCH2、JAG1、HES1 mRNA水平以及血清IL-17、γ干扰素、TNF-α水平均升高（均P<0.05），且NOTCH1、NOTCH2及HES1 mRNA在复杂型HSP组的表达显著高于单纯型HSP组（均P<0.05）。NOTCH1 mRNA水平与JAG1、HES1 mRNA水平及炎症因子（γ干扰素、TNF-α）呈正相关（均P<0.05）；NOTCH2 mRNA水平与IL-17、γ干扰素呈正相关（均P<0.05）。结论Notch信号通路在HSP急性期被显著激活，可能通过调控炎症因子分泌参与疾病的免疫病理过程，NOTCH1、NOTCH2 mRNA的表达水平可能与病情严重程度相关。Keywords: 过敏性紫癜, 儿童, Notch信号通路, 炎症因子, 观察性研究 HSP是一种由IgA介导的血管变态反应性出血性疾病，其病理机制为免疫复合物在血管内沉积，导致血管壁损伤。该病临床上以皮肤紫癜和黏膜出血为主要特征，好发于3~10岁儿童，其中以7~14岁发病率最高，总体年发病率为（13.5~18.0）/10万［1］。HSP的临床表现多样，可累及皮肤、关节、消化道及肾脏，并可波及中枢神经系统和呼吸系统，引发消化道穿孔、消化道出血、肾功能不全等危及生命的并发症。目前，该病确切病因尚未明确，多与感染、食物、药物等因素相关，并涉及B细胞功能亢进、T细胞调节异常，以及多种细胞因子（如IL-17A、IL-18、IL-23）。研究发现，幼年特发性关节炎中Notch信号通路激活与多种炎症因子水平升高密切相关［2］，而HSP与幼年特发性关节炎均属于免疫介导炎症性疾病，两者均涉及T细胞免疫异常及炎症因子失衡，提示Notch信号通路可能在HSP免疫炎症调控中亦具有潜在作用。 哺乳动物有四种Notch受体（Notch1~Notch4）和五种Notch配体（DLL1、DLL3、DLL4、Jagged1和Jagged2）［3］。HES1是Notch信号通路激活后最重要的下游转录靶基因之一，通过抑制靶基因转录参与细胞分化、增殖及免疫调节［4］。Notch信号产生依赖于相邻细胞间Notch配体与受体相互作用。这些配体的胞外域含多个表皮生长因子样重复序列以及氨基端的DSL（Delta/Serrate/Lag2）结构域［5］。配体与受体结合后，经过一系列复杂途径生成Notch蛋白的活化形式NICD，随后NICD进入细胞核，发挥信号传递作用［6］。在多种自身免疫病中，Notch信号通路均参与B淋巴细胞增殖和抗体形成［7］，但其在儿童HSP中的研究相对缺乏。本研究通过检测HSP患儿Notch受体及相关炎症因子水平，探讨Notch信号通路与HSP患儿炎症反应的相关性。 pmc-13186393.title: Research on railway emergency resource scheduling strategy under multiple uncertainty coupling
pmc-13186393.creator: Jianping Sun, Yuyang Wan, Guangle Lu, Zhaoping Tang
pmc-13186393.description: To address the multiple sources of uncertainty in railway emergency resource scheduling, this study uses interval numbers to characterize uncertainty in scheduling time, models resource demand as a fuzzy-random variable, and integrates fuzzy credibility constraints with interval programming within a unified optimization framework.

pmc-13313182.title: Nucleotide variations in 3’ untranslated region contribute to the enhanced virulence and replication efficiency of reemerging Japanese encephalitis virus genotype V
pmc-13313182.creator: Qiqi Xia, Yan Zhang, Jiayang Zheng, Ke Liu, Beibei Li, Zongjie Li, Donghua Shao, Yafeng Qiu, Zhiyong Ma, Jianchao Wei

pmc-13317807.title: Gallstone Ileus With Atypical Gastrointestinal Bleeding: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-13317807.creator: Armando Viramontes, Mario Alberto Munoz Flores, Carlos Javier Mares Jimenez, Eduardo Enrique Soto Ruiz, Jazmin Baca-Moreno
pmc-13317807.description: Gallstone ileus is a rare complication of cholelithiasis. Its diagnosis is challenging due to a nonspecific presentation and high morbidity and mortality related to age and comorbidities. An 87-year-old female with a history of hypertension presented with obstructive abdominal pain, hyporexia, and "coffee-ground" emesis.

pmc-13322177.title: Snowmelt predicts earlier breeding across the latitudinal range of an Arctic nesting seabird, the Little Auk (Alle alle)
pmc-13322177.creator: Martyna Syposz, Øystein Varpe, Sébastien Descamps, Jérôme Fort, David Grémillet, Ann Harding, Dariusz Jakubas, Dorota Kidawa, Nomikos Skyllas, Hallvard Strøm, Tom S L Versluijs, Katarzyna Wojczulanis‐Jakubas
pmc-13322177.description: Climate‐driven temporal shifts in seasonal environments are altering some of the environmental cues that organisms use to time reproduction, potentially leading to trophic mismatches across ecosystems. In the Arctic, marine predators must balance conditions at sea with local terrestrial constraints at breeding sites, yet the relative importance of these cues for breeding phenology remains unclear.

pmc-13539500.title: Quercetin modulates the aggregation behavior of bovine hemoglobin
pmc-13539500.creator: Alexandra Busuioc, Vlad Tudor Popa, Aurica Precupas
pmc-13539500.description: The effect of different concentrations of quercetin (QUER) on bovine hemoglobin (BHb) conformation and thermal stability was investigated using differential scanning microcalorimetry (µDSC), circular dichroism (CD), dynamic light scattering (DLS), Thioflavin T, Congo Red, and ANS binding assays. Both QUER concentration and incubation temperature modulate the aggregation behavior of BHb.
